note: USD per 1M tokens, list prices from platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-10-10); negotiated discounts aren't included. 'claude-code' sources mean the input, output, 5-minute write and read prices were also fitted from Claude Code's own cost-state records. 'cacheWrite' is the 5-minute cache write price and 'cacheWrite1h' the 1-hour one; a model without 'cacheWrite1h' uses 2x its input price, the documented multiplier. 'above' prices apply when a request's prompt (input + cache write + cache read) exceeds 'tokens'. 'regionalPremium' applies only to requests Burn detects as regional or US-only: Bedrock us./eu./... profiles, Claude API inference_geo us, Vertex non-global regions. Set it to 1 to price everything at list. Set a model to null to mark it unpriced. Model keys have region prefixes, 'anthropic.', '[1m]', date and '-v1:0' suffixes stripped.
